Our [From.GetResearchers] have detected a concentration of isochronal signals near [society_planet.GetName].

Initial analysis indicated that these signals have been transmitted from a dimension beyond our own. Early translations suggest that these messages relate to logical principles and philosophical quandaries. Perhaps this is an attempt at intellectual enrichment from entities beyond our comprehension.

If we establish a direct feed with these signals we can continue to monitor their revelations.

summary.text:
# 发现跨次元回声 / Interdimensional Echo Discovered

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud

## 如何开始 How it starts

迷信者（Superstitious Beliefs）文明的周期事件触发：每个13年周期开始（首个周期除外）掷出吉或凶（shroud.210/220/230 → 410/415，events/shroud_events.txt:961-1221），再从 on_action 的16个等权事件中抽取一个（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5749-5789）；本事件每个帝国至多一次（国家旗标 shroud_525_triggered）。吉兆事件。边境内有无人口、不可采矿的行星；游牧民则需驿站舰船所在恒星系可有社会矿藏。分流 shroud.525 → 526（游牧）或 527（恒星系事件）。

Triggered by the cycles of a Superstitious Beliefs empire: each 13-year cycle (except the first) rolls good or bad luck (shroud.210/220/230 → 410/415, events/shroud_events.txt:961-1221) and one of the 16 equally weighted events of that on_action is drawn (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5749-5789); this event happens at most once per empire (country flag shroud_525_triggered). A good luck event. A planet inside the borders with no pops and no mining-station deposit; nomads need a waystation ship in a system that can have society deposits. Router shroud.525 → 526 (nomad) or 527 (system event).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单窗口通知，无后续剧情；唯一的选项直接生效。唯一选项：该行星获得 d_society_7（跨次元回声）矿藏。

A single notification window with no continuation; its only option applies directly. Only option: the planet gains the d_society_7 deposit (the interdimensional echo).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无分支；与同一抽取池中另外15个事件互不相关，各自独立成卡。

No branching; independent of the other 15 events of the same draw pool, each shown as its own card.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

526 与 527 互斥。

526 and 527 are mutually exclusive.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5749-5789`; `events/shroud_events.txt:645-760,961-1221`; `common/scripted_variables/09_scripted_variables_shroud.txt:43`; `events/shroud_events.txt:1631-1754`
- 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.
对照脚本核实了触发条件、旗标、选项效果和本地化；触发链（周期→吉凶掷骰→on_action）已核对。

Trigger, flag, option effects and localisation were checked against the script; the trigger chain (cycle → luck roll → on_action) was verified.
